title: Aircastle Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results
summary: Aircastle Limited, a commercial aircraft leasing company, reported Q4 fiscal 2025 net income of $57 million on total revenues of $251 million, and full-year net income of $194 million, up 57% from fiscal 2024. The company acquired 46 aircraft for $1.7 billion during the year and raised $1.25 billion in new financings, including a $650 million unsecured senior note issuance and $600 million unsecured term loan.
key_points: Q4 FY2025 net income: $57 million on revenues of $251 million, up 22% year-over-year in total revenue
Full-year FY2025 net income: $194 million, up 57% compared to $124 million in FY2024
Acquired 46 aircraft for $1.7 billion; sold 33 aircraft for proceeds of $730 million with gains on sale of $96 million
New financings of $1.25 billion: $650 million unsecured senior notes at 5.000% and $600 million unsecured term loan with 18 lenders
Rating upgrades to Baa2 (Moody's) and BBB (S&P)
Fleet of 277 owned aircraft with net book value of $8.5 billion as of February 28, 2026; 51% new technology aircraft by NBV
CEO noted Middle East events creating fuel cost uncertainties for airlines but characterized demand as sustaining
